raw.purpose: This file defines a mapping of HTTP status codes to their names, providing a convenient way to access these codes either as dictionary items or attributes. It is used throughout the requests library to check and handle HTTP responses.

invariants.claim: Status codes are case-insensitive and can be accessed using either their numerical value or their names.

gotchas.claim: The status code 200 has multiple names, including '\o/' and '✓', which can lead to unexpected behavior if not handled carefully.

open_questions: What is the purpose of the `_init()` function and why is it necessary?
Are there any potential issues with the case-insensitivity of status code names?
How should the library handle status codes that have multiple names?
